output.summary: A perennial herb native to Europe, Asia, Africa and North America. It spreads by rooting runners and bears tight spikes of purple, sometimes white, two-lipped flowers. Young leaves and stems are eaten raw, the whole plant boiled as a vegetable, and above-ground parts brewed cold as a drink.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves and stems are eaten raw; the whole plant is boiled as a vegetable, and aerial parts make a cold-infused beverage.
